rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice in Hong Kong when the wine is understood to be red wine or the context makes that clear.

example.english: This red wine goes down smoothly.
example.jyutping: ni1 zi1 hung4 zau2 gei2 seon6 hau2 wo3

rows.note: Use this precise term for grape wine, including when you do not want to specify its colour.

example.english: The alcohol content of grape wine varies.
example.traditional: 葡萄酒嘅酒精濃度各有唔同。
example.jyutping: pou4 tou4 zau2 ge3 zau2 zing1 nung4 dou6 gok3 jau5 m4 tung4

rows.note: Use this broader noun for an alcoholic drink such as rice wine, fruit wine, or plum wine when the exact type is clear from context.

example.english: Plum wine tastes best when served cold.
example.jyutping: mui4 zau2 dung3 jam2 sin1 hou2 jam2

rows.note: Use this serving construction, normally with 杯 as the classifier, for a glass or serving of wine.

example.english: Please give me a glass of wine.
example.jyutping: maa4 faan4 bei2 ngo5 jat1 bui1 zau2 m4 goi1
